section.title: Purpose
section.para: This document states the system requirements (SRQs) of JetOS. The high level requirements of the JetOS functions, which are written in the headers of the functions and published in the function documentation (docs/kernel.pdf and docs/boards.pdf), are traced to the requirements of this document.

section.title: Scope: what JetOS is
section.para: In this document, JetOS is the software that runs in the privileged mode of the processor of a module and shares the module between partitions. It consists of:

listitem.para: the kernel (kernel/): the architecture independent core, the code of the supported processor architectures (x86_64 and arm64) and the support library of the kernel;
the board support packages (boards/): x86_64-qemu and arm64-qemu.

section.para: The following are not part of JetOS as defined here, and have, or will have, requirements documents of their own:

listitem.para: the examples, the tests and the benchmarks.

section.para: The services that the kernel provides to partitions through system calls, including those that the APEX interface is built on (partitions, processes, time, ports, health monitoring), are in the scope of this document; they are stated as the behaviour of the kernel, not as the APEX services.

section.title: Conventions
section.para: A requirement has an identifier of the form SRQ-JET-AREA-NNN, where AREA names the chapter of the requirement. An identifier is never changed and never used again for another requirement. A requirement states, with shall, one behaviour of JetOS that can be verified; its rationale and its verification method (test, analysis or review) follow it.

listitem.para: The computer that JetOS runs on: a processor, its memory and its devices.
A program that JetOS runs in the unprivileged mode of the processor, in an address space and in time windows of its own.
The time since the start of the module, in nanoseconds.
